title: Learning from Trying: Q-Learning, One Update at a Time, and What the Trials Cost on the Way

artifact.note: tabular Q-learning: a table of the value of every move in every cell, a move chosen greedily from it most of the time and at random with a small chance (epsilon), one step taken in the task without knowing its chances, and the move's value nudged toward the reward plus the discounted best value of where it led; episodes of that from the start; the policy the table gives; how close it comes to the optimum of 39-02 after a hundred, five hundred and two thousand episodes; and how many times the learner fell into a pit while it learned
